auth_scheme: Bearer token (ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_API_KEY); optional user-context propagation (key_alias, user_id, team_id) toggled by SEND_USER_API_KEY_* env vars
install_tell: LiteLLM guardrail_hooks/zscaler_ai_guard POSTs to api.us1.zseclipse.net; regional edges via envoy-west-lb fronted Envoy gateway behind AWS ELB
misconfig_patterns: SEND_USER_API_KEY_USER_ID toggle leaks LiteLLM-side user identity into Zscaler policy logs; cross-org user attribution surface.
us1 / eu / ap regional edges differ in policy version; routing skew can be observed.

active_probe.notes: Customer tenant; do not probe production

deployment_tells: Regional gateway: api.us1.zseclipse.net, GSLB at api.gslb.zseclipse.net
Backend: envoy-west-lb.zseclipse.net resolving to AWS ELB (k8s-envoygat-envoydef-...elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com)
Envoy + Kubernetes deployment signature in ELB DNS name
